description: Ministry of Provincial Councils & Local Government - Regulations made to amend the Local Loans & Development (Miscellaneous) Regulations No. 1 of 1995
categorisation: This gazette content contains regulations made under the Local Loans and Development Ordinance, specifically amending existing regulations regarding loan granting procedures and definitions. It represents a legal/regulatory amendment to existing statutory instruments, which falls squarely under Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) as it involves regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
